objective: Enumerate the daily active-theme timeline, recurrent theme episodes, leader hierarchy, leader changes, rear-stock outcomes, and capacity-core relationships for the fixed study window. This is descriptive/explanatory research, not a trading strategy or profitability backtest.

source_policy.reference_methodology: C:\Project Rocket\02 Strategy Analysis\交易与心性_A股复盘方法论与案例汇编_2026-07末至09.md

primary_kpl_fields.primary_theme_label: Use trimmed lu_desc when non-empty. For rows without lu_desc, retain a separately flagged first-token theme fallback for broken-board diagnostics only. Preserve all raw labels and never silently merge aliases.

status_parse.unparsed: retain raw status, flag parse failure, never impute

theme_activity_rules.active_day: A theme is active when it has at least 3 closed limit-ups, or at least 2 closed limit-ups with at least one board_count >= 2. A day with >=10 closed limit-ups is always active.
theme_activity_rules.extreme_gap_day: limit_up_count <= 2, first_board_count == 0, middle_ladder_count_2_to_3 == 0, and all surviving limit-ups are board_count >= 4
theme_activity_rules.research_universe_theme: A theme enters the headline universe if it ranks in the daily top five on at least one date or has >=10 closed limit-ups on at least one date.
theme_activity_rules.broad_appendix_theme: Any non-empty primary theme with at least one closed limit-up in the study window.

ranking_policy.principle: Produce visible component scores and a deterministic combined rank. Do not let one isolated high board outrank a broad, viable theme solely because of height.

components.height_depth: within-date percentile of sum over closed limit-ups of min(board_count, 5)
components.ladder: within-date percentile of ladder_completeness multiplied by log1p(distinct_board_levels)
components.quality: within-date percentile of inverse broken_board_rate, using missing when no closed or broken boards

ranking_policy.extreme_gap_cap: An extreme-gap theme cannot rank above an otherwise active non-gap theme. Preserve its uncapped score for audit.
ranking_policy.daily_display: Top five active themes, plus every additional active theme with >=10 closed limit-ups.
ranking_policy.sensitivity: Also produce ranks for breadth-first and ladder-first lexicographic alternatives and report top-five agreement.

episode_policy.episode_start: First active day after at least one fade day or before any earlier observation in the window.
episode_policy.episode_end: Last active day before the next fade day.
episode_policy.strict_recurrence: Same raw primary theme begins a later episode after at least one zero-limit-up trading day.
episode_policy.gap_recurrence: Same raw primary theme begins a later episode after at least one extreme-gap day.
episode_policy.do_not_merge: Do not merge different raw labels without an explicit alias mapping table and evidence. Report raw-label recurrence as primary.

stock_role_policy.role_freeze_date: First date an episode appears in the daily displayed set. Use only information available through that date.
initial_ranking: ts_code ascending as deterministic final tie-break

roles.ActiveRear: other KPL stocks assigned to the theme on role_freeze_date

stock_role_policy.realized_leader: Separately record the descriptive episode stock with the highest attained board_count, then peak return, then earliest attainment. Never substitute this hindsight label into initial-role comparisons.
stock_role_policy.leader_switch_within_episode: Daily realized leader ts_code changes while the same episode remains active.
stock_role_policy.leader_switch_after_fade: Representative realized leader differs between recurrent episodes of the same raw theme.

return_policy.source: tbl_cn_day daily pct_chg compounded; do not use raw-price ratios across corporate actions when pct_chg is available
return_policy.episode_reference: Compound from role_freeze_date through episode_end inclusive. Also report maximum cumulative return and maximum drawdown over that interval.
return_policy.post_fade: For each role, report best rebound and worst drawdown over the next 5 trading days when available.
return_policy.ytd_2026: Compound 2026 daily pct_chg through 2026-08-31. For stocks first listed in 2026, start at the first valid pct_chg and flag partial_year.

capacity_core_policy.membership_source: Use tbl_cn_kpl_concept_cons only when raw primary theme exactly matches concept_name on the role_freeze_date snapshot. Never use a future snapshot.
capacity_core_policy.candidate_filter: Member must be in the top 20 percent of theme circ_mv and top 30 percent of theme amount on role_freeze_date, with non-missing daily return.
capacity_core_policy.capacity_score: 0.55 within-theme circ_mv percentile + 0.35 amount percentile + 0.10 return percentile
capacity_core_policy.selection: Keep the top one and runner-up when eligible. Flag themes with no exact concept mapping or no eligible candidate.
capacity_core_policy.state: For each episode day classify core as strong, holding, or weak using relative return versus theme equal-weight return and rolling 3-day cumulative relative return. Keep the raw values and thresholds in outputs.
comparisons: episode duration with versus without a clear core
lag in days from first core weak signal to episode end
recurrence rate with versus without a clear core

quality_gates: All source SQLite connections use read-only URI mode and PRAGMA query_only=ON.
Every study trading date is explicit; dates missing from a theme are treated as zero theme limit-ups, not as missing market dates.
Raw KPL theme labels and statuses are preserved.
Initial leader roles use no post-freeze information.
Hindsight representative leaders are visibly labeled descriptive.
No theme with an unparsed status silently enters a height metric.
All denominators and mapping coverage counts appear in DATA_QUALITY.json.
Outputs are deterministic and byte-stable for unchanged inputs.
Conclusions remain descriptive and do not recommend trades.
